Inventory Points, you may suffer 1d8 Instability Points to ignore that cost.

props.description: You consume a creature's psyche. The target loses 【HR + 20】 Mind Points. Then, you recover an amount of Mind Points equal to half the Mind Points loss they suffered (if the loss was reduced to 0 in some way, you recover none).
props.custom_logic_resolution:
// Drain Spirit — Custom Logic - Resolution

// Effect handled here:

// If the spell hits, restore MP to the caster equal to half the MP actually lost by the target, rounded up.

//

// Important:

// - The normal action pipeline already applies the MP Burn.

// - This script only adds the drain / restore part.

// - It carefully handles low-MP targets.

// Example: planned burn is 15, target has only 3 MP → actual loss is 3 → caster restores ceil(3 / 2) = 2 MP.

const TAG = "[CL-RES][Drain Spirit]";

const p = (typeof __PAYLOAD !== "undefined" && __PAYLOAD) ? __PAYLOAD : {};

const args = (typeof __ARGS !== "undefined" && __ARGS) ? __ARGS : {};

const targetsFromGlobal = (typeof __TARGETS !== "undefined" && Array.isArray(__TARGETS)) ? __TARGETS : [];

p.meta = p.meta || {};

const num = (v, fallback = 0) => {

const n = Number(v);

return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;

};

const parseBaseValue = (v) => {

const raw = String(v ?? "0").trim().replace(/^\+/, "");

const n = Number(raw);

if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n;

const match = raw.match(/-?\d+(\.\d+)?/);

return match ? Number(match[0]) : 0;

};

const unique = (arr) => Array.from(new Set(

(Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [])

.filter(Boolean)

.map(String)

));

const targetUuids = unique([

...targetsFromGlobal,

...(Array.isArray(args.originalTargetUUIDs) ? args.originalTargetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(p.originalTargetUUIDs) ? p.originalTargetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(p.meta?.originalTargetUUIDs) ? p.meta.originalTargetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [])

]);

const attackerUuid =

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.meta?.attackerTokenUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerActorUuid ??

args?.attackerUuid ??

p?.advPayload?.attackerUuid ??

null;

if (!targetUuids.length) {

console.warn(TAG, "No targets found. Drain restore skipped.");

return;

}

if (!attackerUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "No attacker/caster UUID found. Drain restore skipped.");

return;

}

function coerceActor(doc) {

return (

doc?.actor ??

((doc?.documentName === "Actor" || doc?.constructor?.name === "Actor") ? doc : null) ??

null

);

}

async function resolveActor(uuid) {

if (!uuid) return null;

const doc = await fromUuid(uuid).catch(() => null);

return coerceActor(doc);

}

async function resolveTokenIdFromUuidish(uuid) {

if (!uuid) return null;

const doc = await fromUuid(uuid).catch(() => null);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.documentName === "Token" || doc.documentName === "TokenDocument") {

return doc.id ?? doc.object?.id ?? doc.document?.id ?? null;

}

const actor = coerceActor(doc);

if (!actor) return null;

const token =

actor.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ??

actor.getActiveTokens?.()?.[0] ??

null;

return token?.id ?? token?.document?.id ?? null;

}

function readMagicDefense(actor) {

const props = actor?.system?.props ?? {};

const direct = Number(props.magic_defense);

if (Number.isFinite(direct)) return direct;

const fallback = Number(props.current_mdef ?? props.mdef ?? 0);

return Number.isFinite(fallback) ? fallback : 0;

}

// Use the final confirm-time packet first, then fallback to the action payload.

const adv = args.advPayload ?? p.advPayload ?? {};

const accuracyTotal = num(

args.accuracyTotal ??

p?.accuracy?.total ??

p?.advPayload?.accuracyTotal,

NaN

);

const forceMiss = !!(

args.forceMiss === true ||

adv.forceMiss === true ||

adv.isFumble === true ||

p?.accuracy?.forceMiss === true ||

p?.accuracy?.isFumble === true ||

p?.meta?.forceMiss === true

);

const autoHit = !!(

!forceMiss &&

(

args.autoHit === true ||

adv.autoHit === true ||

adv.isCrit === true ||

p?.accuracy?.autoHit === true ||

p?.accuracy?.isCrit === true

)

);

// Rebuild the same simple MP Burn amount from the action packet.

// For Drain Spirit in your screenshot, this should usually become HR + 15.

const base = parseBaseValue(adv.baseValue ?? args.baseValue ?? p?.advPayload?.baseValue ?? 0);

const bonus = num(adv.bonus ?? args.bonus ?? 0);

const reduction = num(adv.reduction ?? args.reduction ?? 0);

const multiplierPct = num(adv.multiplier ?? args.multiplier ?? 100, 100);

const plannedMpBurn = Math.ceil(

Math.max(base - reduction + bonus, 0) * (multiplierPct / 100)

);

if (plannedMpBurn <= 0) {

console.log(TAG, "No planned MP burn found. Drain restore skipped.", {

base,

bonus,

reduction,

multiplierPct,

plannedMpBurn

});

return;

}

let totalMpActuallyLost = 0;

const targetResults = [];

for (const targetUuid of targetUuids) {

const targetActor = await resolveActor(targetUuid);

if (!targetActor) {

targetResults.push({

targetUuid,

hit: false,

reason: "target_actor_not_found",

actualMpLoss: 0

});

continue;

}

const props = targetActor.system?.props ?? {};

const magicDefense = readMagicDefense(targetActor);

const hit = autoHit || (

!forceMiss &&

Number.isFinite(accuracyTotal) &&

accuracyTotal >= magicDefense

);

const targetCurrentMp = Math.max(0, num(props.current_mp, 0));

// Overflow-safe drain:

// If the target only has 3 MP left, they can only lose 3 MP,

// even if the spell's planned MP Burn is 15+.

const actualMpLoss = hit

? Math.min(targetCurrentMp, plannedMpBurn)

: 0;

totalMpActuallyLost += actualMpLoss;

targetResults.push({

target: targetActor.name,

targetUuid,

accuracyTotal,

magicDefense,

forceMiss,

autoHit,

hit,

targetCurrentMp,

plannedMpBurn,

actualMpLoss

});

}

const restoreAmount = Math.ceil(totalMpActuallyLost / 2);

p.meta.drainSpirit = {

plannedMpBurn,

totalMpActuallyLost,

restoreAmount,

targetResults

};

console.log(TAG, "Drain calculation complete.", p.meta.drainSpirit);

if (restoreAmount <= 0) {

console.log(TAG, "No MP was actually lost, so no MP is restored.");

return;

}

const casterTokenId = await resolveTokenIdFromUuidish(attackerUuid);

if (!casterTokenId) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not find caster token on the scene. Cannot restore through AdvanceDamage.", {

attackerUuid,

restoreAmount

});

return;

}

const ADV = game.macros.getName("AdvanceDamage");

if (!ADV) {

ui.notifications?.warn("Drain Spirit: AdvanceDamage macro not found.");

console.warn(TAG, "AdvanceDamage macro not found.");

return;

}

// Restore MP through AdvanceDamage.

// Do not pass the full actionContext here, because we only want the blue MP recovery,

// not a second replay of the original action animation.

await ADV.execute({

__AUTO: true,

__PAYLOAD: {

targetIds: [casterTokenId],

baseValue: `+${restoreAmount}`,

reduction: 0,

bonus: 0,

multiplier: 100,

weaponType: "none_ef",

elementType: "mp",

valueType: "mp",

targetAffinity: "neutral",

ignoreDamageReduction: true,

ignoreShield: true,

attackerUuid,

attackerName:

p?.meta?.attackerName ??

p?.core?.attackerName ??

"Drain Spirit",

attackRange:

p?.meta?.attackRange ??

p?.advPayload?.attackRange ??

"Range",

sourceType: "Skill",

skillName: `${p?.core?.skillName ?? "Drain Spirit"} — MP Drain`,

damageBatchId:

args?.damageBatchId ??

p?.damageBatchId ??

p?.meta?.damageBatchId ??

"",

battleLogBatchId:

args?.battleLogBatchId ??

p?.battleLogBatchId ??

p?.meta?.battleLogBatchId ??

p?.meta?.damageBatchId ??

"",

animationScriptRaw: ""

}

});

console.log(TAG, `Restored ${restoreAmount} MP to caster.`, {

plannedMpBurn,

totalMpActuallyLost,

restoreAmount

});

props.description: You trap a foe inside a circle of altered time and space. The target will perform one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).
props.animation_script:
// ============================================================================

// Stop - Sequencer (Pipeline Version + PSEUDO step forward / step back)

// - Pseudo handles movement only (visual clone, no real token movement)

// - Sequencer handles ALL VFX + SFX

// - CHANGE: Caster VFX is centered on the PSEUDO clone position (not the real token)

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Stop]";

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

// Minimal ONI.emit helper

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

// -----------------------------

// TUNING KNOBS

// -----------------------------

const MOVE_DURATION = 350; // ms (caster step forward/back)

const STEP_SQUARES = 0.35; // how far to step (in grid squares)

const POST_CAST_WAIT = 2000; // ms

const EST_CAST_VFX_MS = 900;

const EST_TARGET_VFX_MS = 1800;

const EXTRA_BUFFER_MS = 250;

const HOLD_FORWARD_MS =

EST_CAST_VFX_MS + POST_CAST_WAIT + EST_TARGET_VFX_MS + EXTRA_BUFFER_MS;

// -----------------------------

// Assets

// -----------------------------

const FX_CASTER =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Cast/CastShapeSquare01_01_Regular_Blue_600x600.webm";

const FX_TARGET =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Energy/IcosahedronRoll_01_Regular_Blue_600x600.webm";

const SFX_BEGIN =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Beginspell.mp3";

const SFX_POISON =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Condition_Poison.ogg";

// -----------------------------

// Payload resolve

// -----------------------------

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.object) return doc.object;

if (doc.document?.object) return doc.document.object;

return null;

}

if (typeof ref === "string") return canvas.tokens.get(ref) ?? null;

return null;

}

function pickTargetsFromPayload(p) {

if (Array.isArray(p.targetTokenIds) && p.targetTokenIds.length) return p.targetTokenIds;

if (Array.isArray(p.targets) && p.targets.length) {

const out = [];

for (const t of p.targets) {

if (typeof t === "string") out.push(t);

else if (t?.tokenId) out.push(t.tokenId);

else if (t?.tokenUuid) out.push(t.tokenUuid);

}

return out.filter(Boolean);

}

if (Array.isArray(p.rows)) {

const out = [];

for (const r of p.rows) {

if (r?.targetTokenId) out.push(r.targetTokenId);

if (r?.targetTokenUuid) out.push(r.targetTokenUuid);

}

if (out.length) return out;

}

return [];

}

const sourceRef =

payload.sourceTokenUuid ??

payload.sourceTokenId ??

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

const targetRefs = pickTargetsFromPayload(payload);

const fallbackSource = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const fallbackTargets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

const sourceToken = (await resolveToken(sourceRef)) ?? fallbackSource;

const targets = [];

for (const r of targetRefs) {

const tok = await resolveToken(r);

if (tok) targets.push(tok);

}

if (!targets.length && fallbackTargets.length) targets.push(...fallbackTargets);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("Stop: No caster token (payload missing and nothing selected).");

return;

}

if (!targets.length) {

ui.notifications.warn("Stop: No targets (payload missing and nothing targeted).");

return;

}

const targetToken = targets[0];

// -----------------------------

// Disposition -> step direction

// -----------------------------

const casterDisposition =

sourceToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ?? sourceToken?.document?.disposition ?? 0;

const casterMoveRight = casterDisposition === -1;

const offsetPx = (canvas.grid.size ?? 100) * STEP_SQUARES;

const dx = casterMoveRight ? +offsetPx : -offsetPx;

// -----------------------------

// Emit START

// -----------------------------

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "stop",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// -----------------------------

// PSEUDO availability

// -----------------------------

const hasPseudo = !!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play;

// Used to tighten animationEnd timing

const pseudoDoneKey = `oni.stop.pseudoDone.${Date.now()}.${foundry.utils.randomID()}`;

globalThis[pseudoDoneKey] = false;

// NEW: live position key for the pseudo clone center (canvas coords)

const pseudoPosKey = `oni.stop.pseudoPos.${Date.now()}.${foundry.utils.randomID()}`;

globalThis[pseudoPosKey] = null;

const waitForPseudoDone = async (timeoutMs = 12000) => {

const start = performance.now();

while (!globalThis[pseudoDoneKey]) {

if (performance.now() - start > timeoutMs) break;

await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 25));

}

};

// Helper to read the pseudo clone position (fallback to token center)

const getCasterVfxLocation = () => {

const p = globalThis[pseudoPosKey];

if (p && Number.isFinite(p.x) && Number.isFinite(p.y)) return { x: p.x, y: p.y };

return { x: sourceToken.center.x, y: sourceToken.center.y };

};

// -----------------------------

// 1) Pseudo session: move out -> HOLD -> move back

// -----------------------------

if (hasPseudo) {

const pseudoScriptSource = `

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("StopPseudo: casterToken missing");

const dx = Number(params.dx ?? 0);

const dur = Number(params.dur ?? 300);

const hold = Number(params.hold ?? 0);

const doneKey = String(params.doneKey ?? "");

const posKey = String(params.posKey ?? "");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;

}

function writePos(obj) {

if (!posKey) return;

globalThis[posKey] = { x: obj.x, y: obj.y };

}

function animate(obj, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const startTime = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - startTime) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = fromX + (toX - fromX) * e;

obj.y = fromY + (toY - fromY) * e;

writePos(obj);

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(update); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) { sprite.width = baseObj.width; sprite.height = baseObj.height; }

sprite.zIndex = 5000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

writePos(sprite); // initial position publish

return sprite;

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

// Hide real token visuals (local only) for the WHOLE session

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

const startX = sprite.x;

const startY = sprite.y;

const outX = startX + dx;

const outY = startY;

// Move out

await animate(sprite, startX, startY, outX, outY, dur);

// Hold while Sequencer VFX/SFX plays

if (hold > 0) {

// keep publishing position during hold (in case other code reads it later)

writePos(sprite);

await wait(hold);

writePos(sprite);

}

// Move back

await animate(sprite, outX, outY, startX, startY, dur);

} finally {

if (sprite) {

writePos(sprite); // final publish

canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite);

sprite.destroy(); // IMPORTANT: no "true"

}

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

// Signal completion back to macro (local flag)

if (doneKey) globalThis[doneKey] = true;

}

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "stop.pseudoSession",

scriptSource: pseudoScriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [targetToken.document.uuid],

params: {

dx,

dur: MOVE_DURATION,

hold: HOLD_FORWARD_MS,

doneKey: pseudoDoneKey,

posKey: pseudoPosKey, // <-- NEW

},

meta: { source: "Stop" },

});

} else {

// Fallback: real token movement (only if pseudo missing)

const original = { x: sourceToken.document.x, y: sourceToken.document.y };

props.animation_script:
/**

* Oni - Pseudo Animation Macro (Foundry VTT v12)

* - Screen dimmer (PIXI)

* - VFX on caster (PIXI video sprite)

* - SFX via Sequencer

* - Wait 2000ms then undim

* - Emits animation start/end signals

*/

(async () => {

const CONFIG = {

// Screen dimmer

DIM_ALPHA: 0.65,

DIM_FADE_IN_MS: 200,

DIM_FADE_OUT_MS: 200,

// Timing

HOLD_MS: 2000,

// VFX (PIXI)

VFX_FILE: "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/1st_Level/Thunderwave/Thunderwave_01_Bright_Blue_Center_600x600.webm",

VFX_SCALE_MULT: 5, // ✅ updated to 3

VFX_FADE_OUT_MS: 250,

// SFX (Sequencer)

SFX_FILE: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Monster2.ogg",

SFX_VOLUME: 0.9

};

const RUN_ID = `${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000)}`;

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

function getCasterToken() {

return canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? globalThis.token ?? null;

}

function tween(displayObject, vars) {

if (!globalThis.gsap) {

ui.notifications.warn("GSAP not found. Tweening may not work on this client.");

Object.assign(displayObject, vars);

return Promise.resolve();

}

return new Promise((resolve) => {

gsap.to(displayObject, { ...vars, onComplete: resolve });

});

}

function emitAnimSignal(eventName, payload) {

// Local hook signal

try { Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload); } catch (e) { /* no-op */ }

// Optional: module socket signal

try {

game.socket?.emit?.("module.fabula-ultima-companion", {

type: eventName,

payload

});

} catch (e) { /* no-op */ }

}

function createScreenDimmer() {

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.beginFill(0x000000, 1);

g.drawRect(0, 0, canvas.dimensions.width, canvas.dimensions.height);

g.endFill();

g.alpha = 0;

g.zIndex = 900000;

g.name = "oni-screen-dimmer";

canvas.stage.addChild(g);

return g;

}

async function loadVfxTexture(src) {

if (globalThis.VideoHelper?.createTexture) return await VideoHelper.createTexture(src);

if (globalThis.VideoHelper?.getOrCreateTexture) return await VideoHelper.getOrCreateTexture(src);

if (globalThis.loadTexture) return await loadTexture(src);

return PIXI.Texture.from(src);

}

function tryStartVideo(texture) {

const res = texture?.baseTexture?.resource;

const vid = res?.source ?? res?.data ?? null;

if (!vid) return;

try {

vid.loop = false;

vid.muted = true; // SFX is separate

vid.play?.();

} catch (e) {

console.warn("[ONI][PseudoAnim] Video autoplay failed:", e);

}

}

async function playVfxOnCaster(caster) {

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

const tex = await loadVfxTexture(CONFIG.VFX_FILE);

tryStartVideo(tex);

const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

spr.anchor.set(0.5);

spr.position.set(caster.center.x, caster.center.y);

// Scale so 600x600 roughly fits the token size, then apply multiplier

const baseScale = (Math.max(caster.w, caster.h) / 600) * CONFIG.VFX_SCALE_MULT;

spr.scale.set(baseScale);

spr.alpha = 1;

spr.zIndex = 900001;

spr.name = "oni-caster-vfx";

canvas.stage.addChild(spr);

return spr;

}

async function playSfxSequencer() {

if (!globalThis.Sequence) {

ui.notifications.warn("Sequencer not found. SFX will be skipped.");

return;

}

try {

await new Sequence()

.sound()

.file(CONFIG.SFX_FILE)

.volume(CONFIG.SFX_VOLUME)

.play();

} catch (e) {

console.warn("[ONI][PseudoAnim] SFX play failed:", e);

}

}

let dimmer = null;

let vfxSprite = null;

let started = false;

let status = "ok";

const basePayload = {

runId: RUN_ID,

// filled after caster exists:

casterName: null,

casterUuid: null

};

try {

const caster = getCasterToken();

if (!caster) {

ui.notifications.error("Select your caster token first.");

return;

}

basePayload.casterName = caster.name ?? caster.actor?.name ?? "Unknown";

basePayload.casterUuid = caster.document?.uuid ?? caster.actor?.uuid ?? null;

// ✅ animation start signal

emitAnimSignal("oni:animationStart", {

...basePayload,

ts: Date.now()

});

started = true;

// 1) Dim the screen

dimmer = createScreenDimmer();

await tween(dimmer, { alpha: CONFIG.DIM_ALPHA, duration: CONFIG.DIM_FADE_IN_MS / 1000 });

// 2) VFX + SFX at the same time

[vfxSprite] = await Promise.all([

playVfxOnCaster(caster),

playSfxSequencer()

]);

// 3) Wait 2000ms

await sleep(CONFIG.HOLD_MS);

// 4) Undim + fade VFX out

await Promise.all([

vfxSprite

? tween(vfxSprite, { alpha: 0, duration: CONFIG.VFX_FADE_OUT_MS / 1000 })

: Promise.resolve(),

tween(dimmer, { alpha: 0, duration: CONFIG.DIM_FADE_OUT_MS / 1000 })

]);

} catch (err) {

status = "error";

console.error("[ONI][PseudoAnim] Macro error:", err);

ui.notifications.error("Animation macro failed. Check console (F12) for details.");

} finally {

// Cleanup (stop video + destroy PIXI objects)

try {

if (vfxSprite) {

const tex = vfxSprite.texture;

const res = tex?.baseTexture?.resource;

const vid = res?.source ?? res?.data ?? null;

vid?.pause?.();

vfxSprite.destroy({ children: true });

}

if (dimmer) dimmer.destroy(true);

} catch (e) {

console.warn("[ONI][PseudoAnim] Cleanup warning:", e);

}

// ✅ animation end signal (fires even if error happened after start)

if (started) {

emitAnimSignal("oni:animationEnd", {

...basePayload,

ts: Date.now(),

status

});

}

}

})();

detectedActionType === "spell" ||

actionTypeDebug?.isSpell === true ||

__PAYLOAD?.meta?.isSpellish === true ||

__PAYLOAD?.dataCore?.isSpell === true;

const isOffensiveSpell = listType === "offensive spell";

if (!isSpellish || !isOffensiveSpell) {

return skipHidden("");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 2) Manual equipped Arcane weapon check

// Avoid the missing helper on your current runtime build.

// --------------------------------------------------

const toBool = (v) =>

v === true || v === "true" || v === 1 || v === "1";

const getProps = (item) =>

item?.system?.props ?? item?.system ?? {};

const normCategory = (v) => {

const s = norm(v);

const aliases = {

arcana: "arcane",

arcane: "arcane",

wand: "arcane",

staff: "arcane",

tome: "arcane"

};

return aliases[s] ?? s;

};

const equippedWeapons = Array.from(passiveOwner?.items ?? []).filter((item) => {

const p = getProps(item);

const isEquipped = [

p?.isEquipped,

p?.equipped,

item?.system?.equipped,

item?.equipped,

item?.isEquipped

].some(toBool);

const itemType = norm(

p?.item_type ??

item?.system?.item_type ??

item?.type ??

""

);

return isEquipped && itemType === "weapon";

});

const hasArcaneWeapon = equippedWeapons.some((item) => {

const p = getProps(item);

const cat = normCategory(

p?.category ??

item?.system?.category ??

item?.category ??

""

);

return cat === "arcane";

});

if (!hasArcaneWeapon) {

return skipHidden("");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 3) Skill level

// --------------------------------------------------

const skillLevel = Math.max(

0,

Number(

passiveItem?.level ??

passiveItem?.system?.props?.level ??

passiveItem?.system?.level ??

passiveItem?.system?.props?.active_level ??

passiveItem?.system?.props?.passive_level ??

0

) || 0

);

const bonusToAdd = skillLevel * 2;

if (bonusToAdd <= 0) {

return skipHidden("");

}

// Update BOTH checkBonus and total.

// --------------------------------------------------

__PAYLOAD.accuracy = __PAYLOAD.accuracy || {};

const beforeCheckBonus = Number(__PAYLOAD?.accuracy?.checkBonus ?? 0) || 0;

const beforeBonusField = Number(__PAYLOAD?.accuracy?.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

const beforeTotalRaw = Number(__PAYLOAD?.accuracy?.total ?? NaN);

// If this spell somehow has no accuracy object, quietly do nothing.

if (beforeTotal === null) {

return skipHidden("");

}

__PAYLOAD.accuracy.checkBonus = beforeCheckBonus + bonusToAdd;

__PAYLOAD.accuracy.bonus = beforeBonusField + bonusToAdd;

__PAYLOAD.accuracy.total = beforeTotal + bonusToAdd;

// --------------------------------------------------

// 5) Debug

// --------------------------------------------------

__PAYLOAD.meta = __PAYLOAD.meta || {};

__PAYLOAD.meta.magicalArtilleryDebug = {

passiveOwner: passiveOwner?.name ?? null,

passiveItem: passiveItem?.name ?? null,

listType,

isSpellish,

isOffensiveSpell,

hasArcaneWeapon,

equippedWeapons: equippedWeapons.map((w) => ({

name: w?.name ?? null,

category: normCategory(

getProps(w)?.category ??

w?.system?.category ??

w?.category ??

""

)

})),

skillLevel,

bonusAdded: bonusToAdd,

checkBonusBefore: beforeCheckBonus,

checkBonusAfter: __PAYLOAD.accuracy.checkBonus,

totalBefore: beforeTotal,

totalAfter: __PAYLOAD.accuracy.total

};
